body:
emily.chen: FYI customer POC is flaky when streaming + tool calls. Repro below.
liam.kumar: Which customer and endpoint?
emily.chen: FinSecure, hitting hosted /v1/chat.completions using model redwood-xy-3-medium. They call a risk_check tool and expect a single JSON payload back. Works with stream=false, fails with stream=true.
anya_support: Can you paste the streamed chunks you saw?
emily.chen: Sanitized stream: 
[chunk] {"role":"tool","name":"risk_check","content":"{\"risk\":\"low\",\"notes\":\"ok\"}"}
[chunk] {"role":"assistant","content":"
Processing OK, returning result"}
[chunk] {"role":"assistant","content":"
{\"verdict\":{\"score\":0.12}}"}
[end stream]

anya_support: That middle assistant chunk injects plain text between JSON pieces so the final concatenation is not valid JSON.
liam.kumar: Error trace from customer: 
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "server.py", line 98, in on_message
    result = json.loads(accumulated)
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Extra data: line 1 column 135 (char 134)

nina_security: They also attached a security questionnaire and asked for encryption-in-transit details. I can prep answers but need product contact.
emily.chen: Sales ask: 1) can we give a Dedicated eval price for 3x-A100 equiv today? 2) ETA for a robust streaming framing fix? 3) Quick QSA reply template?
liam.kumar: Short answers: we can offer a 14-day Dedicated eval credit; rough price $28k/month list for 3x-A100 equiv, we can apply a 20% trial discount. Need finance sign-off.
anya_support: On the streaming side, workaround for now: request stream=false OR system prompt forcing only JSON output. Example: "SYSTEM: OUTPUT_ONLY_JSON" and user instruction: "Return exactly one JSON object, no commentary, no markdown, no fences."
liam.kumar: SDK mitigation: assemble only assistant chunks that occur after tool_end marker; additionally strip surrounding backticks before parse. Not perfect but reduces failures.
emily.chen: Customer tried backtick-stripping, still edge cases when assistant emits extra keys or splits objects.
liam.kumar: Eng update: there is an eng-runtime PR to insert explicit framing tokens between tool and assistant streams and an optional runtime flag strict_json_stream=true that will abort the stream on any non-json token. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/eng-runtime/pulls/4899
deploy-bot: CI queued for PR 4899. Unit tests: 420 passed, integration flaky: 3 failing, retry scheduled.
nina_security: I'll scaffold a QSA reply: TLS 1.2+ enforced, mutual TLS optional for Dedicated, KMS for customer-managed keys, audit logs available. Sending draft separately.
emily.chen: Action items: emily -> send provisional quote and schedule call; liam -> paste minimal mitigation snippet in thread; anya -> help customer try prompt-level guard; nina -> send QSA draft to customer contacts.
liam.kumar: Mitigation snippet (pseudo): 
# assemble stream and validate
buf = ""
for ev in stream:
  if ev[\'role\'] == "assistant":
    buf += ev[\'content\']
# strip fences
buf = re.sub(r"^```+|```+$", "", buf)
# quick validation attempt
try:
  parsed = json.loads(buf)
except Exception:
  # fall back to non-streaming or retry\  raise

anya_support: That regex helped them ~60% but not all. We need runtime support.
liam.kumar: ETA from eng-runtime: internal canary in 48-72 hours if CI is green, GA in ~7 business days pending tests.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled once PR CI is green. Will post updates.
emily.chen: I'll tell customer the short-term options (disable stream or try strict prompt + SDK filter) and propose a triage call to reproduce with streaming enabled.
liam.kumar: Also offered to bump Dedicated quota for a short eval if ops approves.
emily.chen: Thanks team. I'll loop finance and security on the call invite.
anya_support: Please add logs and a minimal reproducible test case to the calendar invite so eng can run it live.
emily.chen: Roger.
